captions: The road light answers again. Thank you for checking with Orro. I am Marn, and I keep an account: a written record of the supplies we have, the current the lamps use, and the households asking for it.

The traders taught my father to measure every crate before he promised it away. That habit kept our stores through a hard winter. It also made it easy for me to give a number to a crate and forget to ask who was carrying it home.
Pella keeps the household readings I missed. Ask her about the missing listening coil in the southern cave. My other readings can wait while you help her.

hint:mission:wammigmig:fair-share.text: Awaken the shrine west of spawn. Inspect the three readings in Wammigmig, east of spawn. Match storage 2, homes 3, street 1; then pulse Homes → Storage → Street. Speak to Marn about the result. Awaken the nearby relay. Inspect storage, hut ledger and household readings. Balance and attune the three conductors. Tell Marn which obligation you will keep.

hint:mission:concordance:road.text: Listen to Orro, wake one light, then confirm its pulse with Marn in Wammigmig. Talk to Orro beside the roadside shrine. Wake the roadside shrine.

story-complete.text: The road light is confirmed. Pella will show you where the missing current begins.
